entities.summary: Sung Jae-gi (b. 1967-09-11, Daegu) was a military leader or commander of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Daegu and South Korea. Known in the fields of south korea, merchants & economists, asia.
